hooks.command: case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" in *apps/frontend/src/*.res*) pnpm --filter @personal-symphony/frontend rescript:build ;; *apps/backend/*.ml*) opam exec -- dune build @all ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" in *"git push origin main"*|*"git push origin master"*|*"git push main"*|*"git push master"*) echo "Blocked direct push to protected trunk branch" >&2; exit 2 ;; esac
case "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" in *"git commit"*) pnpm test && pnpm frontend:test ;; esac

printf '
=== Personal Symphony context refresh ===
'; sed -n '1,30p' CLAUDE.md; printf '
Landmines:
'; sed -n '/^## Landmines/,$p' AGENTS.md | sed -n '1,18p'
find AGENTS.md CLAUDE.md -maxdepth 0 -mtime +14 -print 2>/dev/null | sed 's/^/Agent config may be stale: /'
